Doctor: "although you can't milk is not a good idea, yoghurts are a good idea because they are probiotics, it help to build up the normal, um gut, gut bacteria back."

Doctor: "if your diarrhoea doesn't go away in a week's time, or if you're passing blood, we need a stool sample" and also: "if you're going about six to eight times a day... you might need to go into hospital... If that happens you get in touch with us again." These statements outline re-evaluation for duration >1 week, blood, high frequency, and implied dehydration risk.
Doctor advises return if worsening: "If that happens you get in touch with us again, all right?" indicating follow-up as needed for worsening symptoms.
